chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Muhammad ibn Sa'id al-Hashimi narrated to us. He said: Furat ibn Ibrahim ibn Furat al-Kufi narrated to us. He said: Muhammad ibn Thahir narrated to us. He said: Al-Husayn ibn Ali al-Abdi — known as Ibn al-Qari — narrated to us. He said: Muhammad ibn Abd al-Wahid al-Wasiti narrated to us. He said: Muhammad ibn Rabi'a narrated to us from Ibrahim ibn Yazid, from Amr ibn Dinar, from Tawus, from Ibn Abbas. He said:

I heard the Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) on the pulpit saying, when word had reached him that some people from Quraysh were denying that he had called Ali the Commander of the Faithful,

he said: O people! God, Mighty and Majestic, sent me to you as a messenger and ordered me to appoint Ali as your emir. Whoever I am their prophet, then Ali is their emir — an authority that God, Mighty and Majestic, has placed over you; and He commanded me to inform you of this, so that you may listen to him and obey him. When he commands you, comply; and when he forbids you from something, desist.

Know that none of you should claim authority over me in my lifetime nor after my death, for God, Blessed and Exalted, has put him in command over you and called him the Commander of the Faithful — and no one before him was called by this name. I have conveyed to you what I was sent with regarding Ali. Whoever obeys me in it has obeyed God, and whoever disobeys me in it has disobeyed God, Mighty and Majestic — he will have no argument before God, Mighty and Majestic, and his end will be what God, Mighty and Majestic, described in His Book:
'Whoever disobeys God and His Messenger and transgresses His limits, He will put him into the Fire to abide eternally therein.' [4:14]

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Faithful — the title given exclusively to Ali ibn Abi Talib by God, according to this hadith
key_terms.تَأْمِيرٌ: Appointment to authority/emirate — the divine authorization of Ali's leadership
key_terms.مَعَاشِرَ النَّاسِ: O people / O assembly of people — a prophetic address formula used in major announcements

ai.seo_question: Did the Prophet Muhammad publicly declare Ali the Commander of the Faithful from the pulpit?
ai.summary: This hadith records the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) publicly declaring Ali ibn Abi Talib as the Commander of the Faithful (Amir al-Mu'minin) from the pulpit, reportedly prompted by members of Quraysh who rejected this title. The Prophet frames this appointment as a divine command, drawing the equation between obedience to Ali and obedience to God, and warns that disobeying this command will lead to eternal punishment, citing Quran 4:14. This narration, transmitted through Ibn Abbas, is significant in the Shia tradition as one of the textual proofs for the explicit designation (nass) of Ali's authority.
